title: Art
description: The art manifest of a dataset: the art files, where each passive tree icon is on the sprite sheets, and the face image of each class and ascendancy. Its SHA-256 identifies it.

files.description: Every art file, each named once.

sprites.description: Per sprite kind, such as "normalActive", one sheet per zoom level, from the lowest zoom to the highest.

classFaces.description: Optional. The name in files of each base class's face, by character id.

ascendancyFaces.description: Optional. The name in files of each ascendancy's face, by ascendancy id.

ArtFile.title: ArtFile
ArtFile.description: A file the manifest lists, which the bucket serves by its SHA-256.

SpriteSheet.title: SpriteSheet
SpriteSheet.description: The icons of one sprite kind at one zoom level. At its zoom, one tree unit takes zoom sheet pixels.

file.description: The name of the sheet's file in files.

coords.description: Each icon's rectangle on the sheet, by icon name.

SheetRect.title: SheetRect
SheetRect.description: A rectangle on a sheet, in sheet pixels.
